fr_olympique_adj.why: English sound-alike painted in stade/piste (Nov 1 2026 MAIRIE6 rehome, crop-edit pi_torch replaces an unhooked hurdle): a girl in a white running vest sprinting along the red track holding up a golden torch with a bright flame. Moved from the planned room R_adj_relation_05 into this room.
fr_olympique_adj.note: Cognate of English Olympic. Olympique means Olympic, about the Olympic Games (les Jeux olympiques; une médaille olympique; la flamme olympique). It also describes anything Olympic-sized (une piscine olympique = a 50-meter pool) and, in sports club names, simply 'athletic' (l'Olympique de Marseille, l'OM). There is no real opposite; un sport non olympique is a sport outside the Games.
